The Context

A family business, rebuilt

Ming-Xiong is my family's seafood retail business in Taipei, doing $1M offline. I co-founded the e-commerce revamp and built the online channel from zero.

MsFresh Market brand identity (msfresh.com.tw)
Building the Channel

From 600 LINE members to 2,500+ monthly orders

  • Launched across LINE, Shopee, and a branded site with 100+ SKUs
  • Grew from 600 LINE members to 2,500+ monthly orders through segmentation and paid acquisition
  • Added $800K+ online on top of the $1M offline business
Full-Funnel Execution

$800K in incremental revenue

I drove $800K in incremental online revenue through full-funnel execution across brand media, sales-led e-commerce ads, and organic content, using platform data and customer feedback to rebalance the channel mix.

The MsFresh channels: the site (msfresh.com.tw), the product line, LINE Official Account, and Shopee
What It Taught Me

P&L ownership, for real

This was my first full P&L ownership: pricing, inventory, acquisition cost, and margin, all mine. It is where consumer marketing stopped being theory.
